causal_history.claim: Duplicate branch rows came from retrying a partially committed batch after acknowledgement lagged behind cursor advancement.

decision_rationale.claim: The branch chose acknowledged-batch checkpointing because it fixes retries explicitly, preserves ordering, and avoids the unique-index masking failure mode.

attempted_path.claim: A savepoint-per-batch approach was tried and abandoned because a crash between commit and acknowledgement still replayed imported rows after restart.

handoff.claim: The next person should add the crash-between-commit-and-ack regression, verify stale PID cleanup, and rerun the duplicate import fixture before merge.

causal_history.claim: The evaluation plan moved to synthetic local review because provider-backed CI would require credentials, be flaky, and risk recording live prompt traffic.

decision_rationale.claim: The branch decided to keep evaluation manual and local so the repo can store only synthetic fixtures and de-identified results while preserving privacy and repeatability.

attempted_path.claim: A live-provider CI smoke test was explored and dropped because it would make the gate noisy and weaken the explicit local opt-in boundary.
